title: Frame Bengal: Data Storytelling for the Frame Fellowship | Studio 1947
description: How we turned Frame Fellowship selection data, 34 candidates across 13 districts, into posters, cards and a district map Bengal could share with pride.
ogTitle: Frame Bengal: Fellowship Data Storytelling | Studio 1947
ogDescription: Posters, candidate cards and a district map that turned fellowship selection data into a story worth sharing.

hero.alt: The Frame Fellowship 2026 campaign: Instagram carousel slides with a district map of Bengal and candidate cards, fanned around a phone on a deep teal ground

body: Frame Bengal (framebengal.com) mentors students at West Bengal's state-level public colleges and universities. It pairs them one-to-one with researchers in academia and industry, and funds summer internships at institutions across India and beyond. The Frame Fellowship 2026 chose 34 candidates from thirteen districts of Bengal, and placed them with project mentors in India, the USA, Germany and France.
Studio 1947 was asked to make that result public. Not as an announcement, but as a story: who these students are, where they come from, and how far the fellowship reaches.

sections.heading: The Brief: Make the Data Tell the Journey

sections.label: The Challenge
body: The raw material was a spreadsheet: 34 names, home districts, home colleges, host institutions. The design work was reading that data closely enough to find the story inside it. A student from Bangabasi College is headed to the University of North Dakota. Purulia and Cooch Behar sit on the same map as Harvard and CNRS Montpellier.
Every design decision followed from one idea. The fellowship is not a list of winners. It is a set of journeys: from a district, through a public college, to a lab somewhere in the world.

cards.title: Data Read Deeply
cards.body: We studied districts, colleges and host institutions until the pattern showed: local roots, global reach.

cards.title: The Journey as the Unit
cards.body: Each candidate is drawn as a route. Home college at the start, mentor institution at the arrow's end.

cards.title: Districts on the Map
cards.body: Jalpaiguri's one fellowship matters as much as Kolkata's seven, so every district is named and counted.

sections.heading: A Map of 34 Futures
sections.label: Data Visualization
body: The anchor poster puts the whole fellowship on one glowing map of Bengal. Thirteen districts are labelled with their fellowship counts: seven in Kolkata, seven in South 24 Parganas, one each in Purulia, Jalpaiguri and Cooch Behar. A header band tallies where the mentors work: 18 in India, 13 in the USA, 2 in Germany, 1 in France.
One image answers the three questions every reader brings: how many, from where, and going how far.

media.alt: Frame Fellowship 2026 poster: district-by-district fellowship counts on a glowing map of West Bengal, with mentor affiliations across India, USA, Germany and France
media.caption: The selection, in one poster: 34 candidates across thirteen districts, with mentors on three continents

sections.heading: 34 Journeys, Card by Card
sections.label: Candidate Cards
body: A ten-page carousel introduces every fellow by name. Each card carries the same quiet diagram: a dotted route from the candidate's home college to their host institution at the arrowhead. Jadavpur University to IIT Gandhinagar. Ramakrishna Mission Residential College to CNRS Montpellier. Bidhannagar College to Harvard.
The frosted-glass cards sit over the district map. So even in a name-by-name listing, the geography of the fellowship never leaves the frame.

sections.heading: The Cards in Motion
sections.label: College Cards
body: One card per fellow, all drawn to the same quiet grammar: a name, a district, and a dotted route from a Bengal college to the institution the fellowship leads to. The host campus itself is the card's background.
The repetition is the design. Because every card holds the same structure, what changes between them is exactly what matters: the names, and how far the routes reach.

media.caption: The candidate cards, journey by journey

cards.title: Every district visible
cards.body: The map gives the whole state a stake in the fellowship. A single fellowship in Purulia reads as proudly as seven in Kolkata.

cards.title: Data made shareable
cards.body: A selection spreadsheet became posters and cards that candidates, colleges and districts could post as their own good news.

cards.title: 34 names, not a number
cards.body: Every fellow is introduced individually, with their college given equal billing to the institution they are headed to.
